info.title: ORCID Member API
info.description:
The ORCID Member API lets ORCID member organizations read and update researchers' ORCID records with their permission. This reference covers the **employment** section of a record.

Every call needs an access token that the record owner granted to your member client through 3-legged OAuth: `https://sandbox.orcid.org/oauth/authorize` to ask for permission, then `https://sandbox.orcid.org/oauth/token` to exchange the code (in production, the same paths on `orcid.org`).

Send `Accept: application/json` on every request. Without it the API answers in XML.

servers.description: Sandbox: test records, safe to experiment

tags.name: Employment
tags.description: Employment affiliations on a researcher's ORCID record: where they work or have worked. Your client can add employments, and can update or delete only the ones it added.

post.description:
Adds an employment affiliation to the record of the user who granted your token. Your client becomes the item's **source**, so only your client can update or delete it later.

The response has **no body**. The new item's put-code is the last segment of the `Location` header: store it if you will update or delete the item.

Requires the `/activities/update` scope. Send `Accept: application/json` so that errors come back as JSON.

requestBody.description: The employment to add. Only `organization` is required.

minimal.description: The smallest valid body. Dates, role and department are all optional.

current-position.description: An ongoing role: send a start date and leave out end-date.

past-position.summary: Past position with dates and URL
past-position.description: A finished role. Partial dates are fine; month and day are zero-padded strings.

with-external-id.description: A `self` external identifier lets ORCID reject a second POST of the same item from your client with 409 (error 9021) instead of creating a duplicate.

missing-city.description: Employment and education need both city and country in the organization address.

put-code-on-create.description: ORCID assigns the put-code. Leave it out when you POST.

unknown-organization.summary: Error: organization not in ORCID's registry
unknown-organization.description: The identifier and source pair must match an organization ORCID already knows.

end-before-start.summary: Error: end date before start date

duplicate.description: The same body as "With an external identifier", sent a second time by the same client.

201.description: Created. **The response has no body.** The new item's put-code is the last segment of the `Location` header.

Location.description: URL of the new employment. Its last segment is the put-code.

minimal.summary: 201 Created (Minimal: organization only): empty body, put-code in Location

current-position.summary: 201 Created (Current position (no end date)): empty body, put-code in Location

past-position.summary: 201 Created (Past position with dates and URL): empty body, put-code in Location

with-external-id.summary: 201 Created (With an external identifier): empty body, put-code in Location

400.description: The body failed validation. `error-code` says which rule.

invalid-json.description: Unknown fields, empty strings, years outside 1900-2100 and similar schema problems. The text after "Full validation error" names the problem.

orcid.name: orcid
orcid.description: The ORCID iD of the record owner: the user who granted your token. Use the `orcid` value from the token response.

putCode.name: putCode
putCode.description: The put-code ORCID assigned when the item was created (the last segment of the `Location` header).

orcidOAuth.description: 3-legged OAuth: the record owner signs in to ORCID and grants your client the scopes. Sandbox URLs are shown; in production use `https://orcid.org/oauth/authorize` and `https://orcid.org/oauth/token`.

scopes./activities/update: Add, update and delete activities, including employment.
scopes./read-limited: Read items the record owner shared with trusted parties.

bearerAuth.description: Paste an access token you already have: the `access_token` from the token response.

Visibility.description: Who can see the item. On create, a claimed record applies the user's own default visibility and ignores this value. On update, leave it out or send the current value: changing it returns 403 (9035).

Day.description: Two-digit day, zero-padded. Only allowed together with a month.

FuzzyDate.description: A full or partial date. Year is required; a day needs a month. The date must exist on the calendar (otherwise 400, error 9049).

Url.description: A URL, wrapped in an object.

OrganizationAddress.description: Employment needs both city and country (otherwise 400, error 9060).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, upper case.

DisambiguatedOrganization.description: A persistent identifier for the organization. The identifier and source pair must match an organization in ORCID's registry, otherwise 400 (error 9045). Prefer ROR.

disambiguated-organization-identifier.description: For ROR, the full ROR URL.

external-id-type.description: An identifier type from ORCID's list, for example `other-id`.

external-id-relationship.description: Use `self` for an identifier of this employment itself. Only `self` identifiers take part in duplicate detection.

EmploymentCreate.description: Body for adding an employment. Do not send `put-code` (400, error 9024).

EmploymentUpdate.description: Body for updating an employment your client added. Send the whole item: fields you leave out are cleared, except visibility, which is kept.

put-code.description: Must equal the put-code in the URL (otherwise 400, error 9019).

Source.description: Who added the item. For items your client adds, `source-client-id` is your client.

EmploymentSummary.description: The summary form of an employment, as listed in `/employments`. Same fields as Employment.

affiliation-group.description: Employments grouped by shared external identifiers.

OAuthError.description: Returned by the token check before the request reaches the API.
